en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four panels, each showing a small European town square with cobblestone streets, 3–4 story historic buildings with steep tiled roofs, and 1950s–1960s cars parked along the streets. The upper left panel features a town hall–like building with a clock tower and cupola. The upper right panel shows a market square with a sculptural fountain in the foreground and a church or gate tower with a pointed roof in the background. The lower panels depict rows of shops and businesses; visible signs include a pharmacy labeled "STADT-APOTHEKE" and other German shop names.
